sentences.text: The Ursids are born from dust left by Comet 8P/Tuttle, which returns every thirteen and a half years.
Tuttle's orbit is inclined fifty-five degrees to the ecliptic; it is now about as far out as Saturn, with its next perihelion in 2035.
Earth passes through this stream just after the solstice; the particles enter the atmosphere at thirty-three kilometres a second.
It is a quiet shower: about ten meteors an hour at peak, but with its radiant in Ursa Minor it stays above the horizon all night in the northern hemisphere.
Rarely, outbursts of over a hundred an hour were recorded in 1945 and 1986.
